question_text: Was the DWP cyber incident that took services offline a hack?
answer_text: Nobody has shown either way yet. DWP says it found a "cyber incident affecting our systems" and took some online services offline on Nov 27. It has not said what kind of incident it was, whether anyone got in or whether data was accessed.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: DWP, the National Cyber Security Centre or another official source saying what the incident was: for example that an outsider got into DWP's systems, or that nobody did.

question_text: Are DWP benefit and pension payments affected?
answer_text: DWP says regular benefit and pension payments are not affected and will be paid as normal. That is the department's own word; nobody outside it has said so yet.
label: Reported

question_text: Which DWP online services are down?
answer_text: DWP has not listed them. The BBC reports that around 12:00 GMT on Nov 27 the online systems for pensions, Universal Credit and PIP applications, and Tell Us Once, could not be accessed, and State Pension applications are down.
label: Reported

question_text: When will DWP online services be back?
what_would_settle_it: DWP saying on GOV.UK, or in a statement reported by a news outlet, that its online services are working again.

question_text: Was personal data taken in the DWP cyber incident?
what_would_settle_it: DWP or the Information Commissioner's Office saying whether any personal data was accessed or taken.

question_text: Should I trust a message about the DWP incident asking for bank details?
answer_text: DWP says it will never message people to ask for bank details or to click on links. If an online service you need is unavailable, it says to try again later.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Was the DWP outage caused by old IT systems rather than hackers?
answer_text: Not established. DWP calls it a cyber incident and has not said what kind. The BBC says it is not clear whether it was a hack or a technical failure, and that there is no evidence at this stage of a breach by hackers.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: DWP or the National Cyber Security Centre saying what caused the incident.

question_text: Is the DWP outage linked to a cryptography breakthrough?
answer_text: Not established. Nothing we have read links the DWP incident to any cryptography finding; the idea comes from discussion threads, not from DWP or any official source. DWP has not said what the incident was.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: DWP or the National Cyber Security Centre saying what caused the incident.
